en: Changed the sandbox on macOS and Linux: `git worktree add`, `move` and `remove` now fail read-only, as do commits in a worktree the session wasn't started in or given, even one inside the project
zh: 变更了 macOS 和 Linux 上的沙箱：`git worktree add`、`move` 和 `remove` 现在会以只读方式失败，在 session 未启动或未指定的 worktree 中提交也会失败，即使该 worktree 位于项目内
